_meta.purpose: Playability gains. Multipliers applied ON TOP of the estimated/literature parameters so that player decisions register on the dashboard within a year or two.
_meta.why: The realistic model says no fiscal or reform strategy moves 2030 GDP per capita by more than 1.1% (SUPPLY.md section 3.2). That is true and it makes for no game. These gains are the single place where realism is traded for playability - the underlying parameters are untouched and auditable, and setting every gain to 1.0 restores the estimated model exactly.
_meta.tuning: Raise to make decisions louder, lower for realism. Target: a good five-year run should move the headline number by 5-8 percent and clearly beat a bad one. infraTfp lowered 4.0 -> 2.2 for the same reason: infrastructure should build capital, not conjure productivity.

gestation.note: 16 quarters (4 years). Briefly ran at 12, which made a first-year megaproject land inside the term and turned building things into a Legacy shortcut — undercutting the whole point that correct long-horizon policy is invisible on the scoreboard. 16 keeps a Q1 commitment barely delivering by 2030 and anything later delivering to a successor.
